title: Consensus
description: JSON Schema for a consensus record: the cellwise ∨_k-join of multiple proposals on a shared target, settled when proposals agree and refusing when they contradict.

combines-proposals.description: References to the proposal records being combined.

for-target.description: Reference to the shared target the proposals address.

settled-value.description: The consensus value when state = settled. Shape depends on the target.

refusal-reason.description: Identifiers of proposals whose contradiction produced the refusal.

combiner.description: Reference to the closure-rule that produced this consensus.
